exposure: Placentas from women with previous cesarean section
cohort: 11 placentas from women with COVID-19, 58 placentas from a pre-COVID-19 control group, and 28 placentas from women with a previous cesarean section
finding: Placentas delivered by women with COVID-19 showed higher frequencies of several pathological findings, including chronic villitis/VUE, chronic deciduitis, microvascular thrombosis, infarction areas, and accelerated villous maturation, but only some remained significant after adjusting for previous cesarean section.
